notes: Implemented in 121dc5c3302ab2d1817dbdfd08d51f35c295782b, closed in cd95df6da586ada5fc10e68ced2d7fb012e53631, and merged in 13c023028cf2cbf151a8bb18109973e6add70606 (#1509); confidence_escalation.rs, engines/token_stream.rs, and learned_classifier.rs were later retired during Lean Core consolidation while consensus_mode.rs and engines/runtime_native.rs remain active in Core.
